question: Which carriers, aircraft, crews, vendors, and authorities can be assigned to CSI Aviation's current ICE Air work after iAero?

historical_not_current: TEM Enterprises dba Avelo Airlines (DHS-charter work ended 2026-01-27)

carrier_edges.operator_role: Part 121 A320-family operator; ACMI supplies aircraft, crew, maintenance, and insurance
carrier_edges.limits: SEC statement does not name ICE, BPA/call, route, aircraft, or crew
No reviewed primary CSI teaming agreement or ICE flight/tail record

carrier_edges.assets: 13 CRJ200 aircraft acquired under a related asset purchase agreement
carrier_edges.limits: Ownership/capability is not an ICE assignment; ordinary CRJ200 capacity is below the 148-adult DSLA minimum

aircraft_observations_not_assignments.assignment_status: no_b43_row; use SEC and DOT authority only

authority_map.subject: ICE Air BPA
authority_map.proves: Prime responsibility for teaming partners/subcontractors; at least 12 DSLA aircraft; minimum 148 adults; aircraft registration and crew qualification reporting

authority_map.subject: GlobalX
authority_map.proves: Interstate and foreign charter authority; GlobalX trade name

authority_map.subject: CSI replacement package
authority_map.authority: Classic Air ECF 37, quoting redacted administrative record
authority_map.proves: CSI submitted replacement commitments, airworthiness certificates, OpSpecs, and teaming agreements in October 2024
authority_map.does_not_prove: Replacement carrier identities or aircraft because public filing is redacted

vendor_role_boundary.GEO Transport / GEO Group: security and air-operations support beneath CSI; no evidence of Part 121 aircraft or crew operation
vendor_role_boundary.CSI Aviation: ICE prime and air-charter coordinator; acquired Air Wisconsin in January 2026
vendor_role_boundary.GlobalX: confirmed aircraft/crew operator under direct CSI U.S.-government contract
